acceptance_criteria: All frozen tool/source hashes and the pinned E1 Cano import identity match before RUNNING.
P01-P04 graph/splines are read only; P05 is constructed exactly once as graph/splines only; new mesh and ray counts remain zero.
Every parent has exactly 50 anchors and the global minimum pairwise Euclidean distance is at least 5 m.
Every structural event candidate is within 5 m of a selected anchor and every tunnel is represented.
Observed non-event fill counts exactly match deterministic spline-arc-length quotas for every tunnel.
Every 0.5 m full-spline coverage probe is within 7.5 m of an event or selected same-tunnel anchor.
A second selector call on each unchanged parent produces the identical canonical anchor hash.
Five complete maps and one aggregate figure show all 250 anchors and full tunnel extents with no selected best cases.
Formal dataset, sensor observation, ray, training, model, trajectory, topology-runtime and M-TARE counts remain zero.
The immutable run completes within 300 seconds and 100 MiB with summary, raw log, RUN_STATE and evidence hashes.
baseline: The v1 selector produced exactly 50 globally spaced anchors per topology, but complete-map review found maximum same-tunnel coverage radii of 32.780 m on P01 and 92.306 m on P03, so it was rejected for LiDAR sampling despite its machine contract PASS.

estimated_cost.compute: One frozen-E1 CPU process using SciPy MILP; four read-only graph/spline parents and one graph-only P05 construction; no mesh, raycasting, GPU, simulator or training.

expected_evidence: Frozen source/tool/environment identities, command, log, duration, exit code, RUN_STATE and evidence hashes
Five anchor JSONs, five per-parent coverage metric JSONs, one P05 graph/spline pair and one input manifest
Five complete X-Y/X-Z anchor maps, one aggregate spacing/coverage figure and provenance
method: Read the sealed P01-P04 graph/spline files by frozen hash and construct only P05 graph/splines once from topology seed 503. Preserve structural events, allocate all non-event anchors across tunnels in proportion to spline arc length, interpolate a 0.5 m candidate and coverage lattice, then solve one deterministic binary MILP with exact per-tunnel quotas, at least 5 m global Euclidean spacing and at most 7.5 m full-spline same-tunnel coverage radius. Replay unchanged inputs and save all 250 anchors, five complete X-Y/X-Z maps and aggregate spacing/coverage evidence. Generate no mesh, rays, labels, formal data or models.
question: Can selector v2 place exactly 50 structural-event-preserving anchors over the full arc-length extent of every fixed tunnel topology while maintaining at least 5 m global spacing and at most 7.5 m same-tunnel coverage radius?
stop_conditions: Any approval, source, environment, hash, scope or output-state mismatch
Any topology-family, exact-count, spacing, event-coverage, tunnel-coverage, arc-length-quota, full-spline-coverage, replay, visualization, time or disk failure
Continuation would require lowering count/spacing, relaxing coverage, changing seed/template, generating mesh/rays, retrying or selecting a replacement parent
